name: Khazarad, Craft Street
desc1: This broad, flagstone-lined street heads through the heart of the
desc2: dwarven city. Meticulously clean, it is flanked by shops and intricate
desc3: stone carvings, and banners of gold hang from the walls. An ornate,
desc4: carved-stone structure stands tall and proud to the north, statues of
desc5: armed dwarven warriors flanking its entrance. A protective aura of
desc6: sorts can be felt surrounding it. To the south, the unmistakeable
desc7: display of a gemcrafter's store glitters and sparkles in the light.
